# Sofiko Tsitskarava — gastroenterologist, dietitian and internist in Tbilisi, Georgia

> Official website of Dr Sofiko Tsitskarava (Софико Цицкарава, სოფიკო ციცქარავა), a gastroenterologist, dietitian and internist with 14+ years of practice. She sees patients in person at Caraps Medline clinic in Tbilisi (Vake, 41 Paliashvili St), holds visiting days in Batumi (Medfam clinic) and consults online worldwide — in Georgian, Russian and English.

Other spellings of her name used online: Sofo / Sopo Tsitskarava, Sofiko Cickarava, Софо Цицкарава, Сопо Цицкарава, Цицкарава Софико Гогиевна, სოფო ციცქარავა. They all refer to the same doctor. Older directory profiles (prodoctorov.ru, krasotaimedicina.ru, zoon.ru, meds.ru) describe her earlier work in Saint Petersburg, Russia; since 2022 she practises in Georgia.

## Practice

- Specialties: gastroenterology, dietetics (nutrition), internal medicine.
- Conditions she sees: heartburn and reflux, gastritis and H. pylori, bloating, IBS, constipation and diarrhoea, liver and gallbladder problems, weight and eating habits, digestion in pregnancy and breastfeeding, general internal-medicine questions.
- Approach: evidence-based medicine; she looks for the cause of symptoms rather than prescribing blanket food bans.
- In person, Tbilisi: Caraps Medline, 41 Paliashvili St (Vake). Clinic phone +995 32 251 60 60. Works with Georgian insurance companies.
- In person, Batumi: Medfam clinic, visiting days; booking by phone +995 591 12 44 22, dates announced on Instagram.
- Online: 60-minute video consultation from anywhere in the world.
- Languages: Georgian, Russian, English.

## How to book

- Instagram direct messages: https://ig.me/m/dr.tsitskarava (@dr.tsitskarava)
- Telegram: https://t.me/dr_tsitskarava (@dr_tsitskarava)
- Clinic phone for in-person visits in Tbilisi: +995 32 251 60 60
- Patients with a Georgian personal ID number can also book through the clinic portal: https://myhealth.carapsmedline.ge/

## Education and credentials

- Medical degree (General Medicine), North-Western State Medical University named after I. I. Mechnikov, Saint Petersburg, 2012.
- Internship in internal medicine, Pavlov First Saint Petersburg State Medical University, 2013.
- Professional retraining in gastroenterology, Pavlov First Saint Petersburg State Medical University, 2015.
- Professional retraining in dietetics, Saint Petersburg State University, 2021.
- Georgian state certificates in internal medicine and in gastroenterology, 2022.
- Lecturer at the Academy of Medical Education (CME seminars for doctors on functional gastrointestinal disorders).
